card.name: Gaps before liver lab thresholds
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word right before a number or term in liver-related text, such as after 'albumin less than' or after 'cirrhotic patient'. It is strongest in lab cutoffs for albumin and in hepatitis C regimens with cirrhosis.
